Membership

Shoreline Leisure Greystones Gym

Train your way. Feel your best.

At Shoreline Leisure Greystones, we’ve got everything you need to reach your fitness goals. Our gym features a full range of treadmills, cross trainers, and exercise bikes for all your cardio needs, plus weight machines and free weights — including dumbbells and kettlebells — to help you build strength and tone your body.

Prefer to train in a group setting? Join one of our energising fitness classes, designed to motivate and challenge every level.

We’re proud to have a welcoming and inclusive community, open to the general public, students, and older adults (55+). Our dual-use equipment also ensures accessibility for members with additional needs.

FACILITIES

  • CARDIO EQUIPMENT

    Get your heart pumping with our wide range of modern cardio machines, including treadmills, bikes, cross-trainers, and rowers. Whether you’re warming up, training for endurance, or just breaking a sweat, our cardio zone keeps your energy high and your goals in sight.

  • FREE WEIGHTS

    Build strength and power with our extensive free weights area. From dumbbells and barbells to benches and racks, this space is perfect for anyone looking to lift, tone, and push their limits in a motivating environment.

  • Assisted Weights Machines

    Train safely and effectively with our selection of assisted weight machines. Designed to support proper form and controlled movement, these machines are ideal for beginners and experienced lifters alike who want to target specific muscle groups..

  • Functional Training Zone

    Enhance your movement, balance, and agility in our functional training zone. Equipped with kettlebells, medicine balls, battle ropes, and more, this dynamic space is built for workouts that translate to real-life strength and performance.

  • Strength & Conditioning Zone

    Take your training to the next level in our dedicated strength & conditioning zone. Perfect for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, this area combines performance-based equipment and open space for explosive, high-intensity workouts.

  • HYROX ZONE

    Push your limits in our HYROX Zone — where strength meets endurance. Inspired by the global HYROX fitness challenge, this area blends functional training, high-intensity cardio, and performance workouts to help you train, compete, and achieve your best.

    Train hard. Perform stronger. HYROX at Shoreline Leisure.

FAQs

  • •Our Gym is Members Only Access
    •Each customer is responsible for disinfecting their chosen equipment Before and After use
    •No persons under the ages of 16 permitted in the gym except at Teen Gym sessions under supervision. Proof of age may be required. NB. On occasion children under 16 may use the gym through a specific programme or under instruction by a qualified individual, i.e. Teen Gym.(13-16 years old)

    • No food, glass bottles or chewing gum allowed.
    • Proper sports attire and footwear must be worn at all times when using the fitness centre.
    • Customers may not use the gym without proper footwear as this may cause injury or damage to the gym equipment. Customers are not permitted to leave bags or personal belongings in the gym area and must use lockers provided.
    •Customers must place the weights and plates back on the racks when they are finished using them.
    •Dropping weights on the floor is not permitted as it can result in injury and damage the weights.

  • Check out our membership options here.

    You can contact us at greystones@shorelineleisure.ie also for further queries

  • Yes, as a member our gym facilities are available to use. However if you are on Off Peak membership you will be restricted to the following hours:

    Shoreline Leisure Greystones Off Peak Hours:
    Monday to Thursday: 6.30am-6pm, Friday 6.30am-9pm, Saturday & Sunday 9am-6pm

  • Yes, throughout your membership you can avail of fitness assessments with any our fully qualified fitness team.

  • Recurring payments, also known as RCPs, are charged automatically to a customer's credit card or bank account at periodic intervals (monthly) when you choose to pay via RCP when joining. Once you have chosen your membership you enter your payment details for the first payment. These details are saved in a payment gateway for processing the subsequent payments securely. The payment is debited according to a predetermined billing schedule. This removes the need to manually type in the payment details for every payment cycle.

  • Yes we have individual lockers in all the changing rooms. Our lockers take a (refundable) €1 coin. Gym bags are not allowed in the gym area. We also have gym changing rooms with showers.

  • To join our gym users need to be 16 years +. If signing up to a student membership we do require a form of ID to process the membership to confirm over 16 years.

  • We do not offer day passes or PAYG options. Our gym is only open for members. If you are interested in joining a member of our team will gladly show you the gym and talk through the best membership option to suit.

What our Gym Members Say

  • “Fantastic gym with a friendly atmosphere!” I’ve been training at Shoreline Greystones for over a year, and I love it. The staff are always welcoming and helpful, and the gym has everything I need — from great cardio machines to a solid weights area.

  • “Great facilities and super clean.” The equipment is top quality and there’s plenty of space, even during busy hours. The classes are brilliant — the instructors keep you motivated and make fitness fun!

  • “Perfect for all fitness levels.” As a beginner, I was nervous joining a gym, but the team at Shoreline Greystones made me feel right at home. They’re supportive, and there’s a great mix of people of all ages and abilities.

  • “Excellent community gym.” I really enjoy training here. It’s clean, well-organised, and has a great sense of community. The variety of classes keeps things interesting, and the atmosphere is always positive.

  • “Love my workouts here!” Shoreline Greystones has everything — cardio, weights, classes, and friendly staff who genuinely care. It’s the perfect place to get fit and feel good.
